claims.content: Customer
Customer is logged in to the system.
Customer has navigated to the 'My Account' section.
Customer logs into the system.
System displays the 'My Account' dashboard page.
Customer views their account summary, including membership level, points balance, and recent orders.
Customer selects a specific management task from the navigation menu (e.g., 'Edit Profile', 'Change Password', 'Address Book').
System loads the corresponding sub-page or form for the selected task.
Customer enters or modifies the required information in the form fields.
Customer clicks the 'Save Changes' or 'Update' button.
System validates the input data.
System saves the updated information to the database.
System displays a success message confirming the update.
Customer remains on the updated page or is redirected back to the main 'My Account' dashboard.
Customer enters invalid or incomplete data in the form fields.
System detects validation errors and displays specific error messages next to the problematic fields, preventing the save operation.
Customer corrects the errors and resubmits the form (returns to Main Flow Step 6).
Customer clicks 'Cancel' or navigates away from the page before saving.
System discards any unsaved changes and redirects the Customer back to the 'My Account' dashboard without updating the database.
The Customer's account information is updated in the system database.
A confirmation message is displayed to the Customer indicating the successful update.
The Customer remains on the current page or is redirected to the 'My Account' dashboard with the updated information reflected.
